scripts.build:extension: corepack yarn workspace @dope/contracts build && corepack yarn workspace @dope/project-intelligence build && corepack yarn workspace @dope/theia-extension build
scripts.build:browser: corepack yarn build:extension && corepack yarn workspace @dope/browser build
scripts.build:electron: corepack yarn build:extension && corepack yarn workspace @dope/electron build
scripts.package:linux: (test -f plugins/vscode.javascript/extension/package.json && test -f plugins/firsttris.vscode-jest-runner/extension/package.json || npm run download:plugins) && npm run build:electron && corepack yarn workspace @dope/electron package:linux
scripts.start:browser: npm run download:plugins && corepack yarn workspace @dope/browser start
scripts.start:electron: npm run download:plugins && corepack yarn workspace @dope/electron start
scripts.test: npm run test:runner && npm run test:baseline && npm run test:product && npm run test:ide
scripts.test:product: npm run build:extension && node --test test/unit/workspace-mode.test.ts test/unit/note-persistence.test.ts test/unit/project-intelligence.test.ts test/unit/project-mind-storage.test.ts test/unit/project-mind-ui.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: corepack yarn workspace @dope/contracts build && corepack yarn workspace @dope/project-intelligence build && tsc -p packages/theia-extension --noEmit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build:browser && npm run build:electron
